title: 2 - Bob Version 2.0
summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] awakens without a body in a future laboratory and learns that he is a computer simulation made by destructively scanning [[character:robert-johansson]]'s frozen brain. [[character:dr-landers]] explains the theocratic society that now claims cryonics patients as property, the competing replicant program, and Bob's place among five candidates for a one-replicant project. Realizing that failure could mean insanity, storage, menial service, or deactivation, Bob resolves to compete while Landers limits his simulated panic and ends the first session.

introducing.name: Bob
introducing.current_state: Awake as one of five candidates competing to control a replicant probe.

introducing.name: Dr. Landers
introducing.description: A doctor at [[organization:applied-synergetics]] in [[location:new-handeltown]] who greets the newly activated [[character:bob-replicant]], a replicant of [[character:robert-johansson]], in 2133 and briefs him on his status and on [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]]. He runs Bob's sessions as one of five candidates for a project that needs only one replicant.

introducing.name: FAITH
introducing.description: The Free American Independent Theocratic Hegemony, a theocratic U.S. government that makes criticism a felony and permits the deactivation of machine persons for it.

introducing.name: Applied Synergetics Inc.
introducing.description: A company that owns [[character:bob-replicant]] as property and develops replicant-controlled machinery.

introducing.name: GUPPI interface
introducing.description: An interface that offloads tasks for replicants while retaining their human limits on multitasking.
